name: ima-knowledge-kit
description: Bring Tencent ima (ima.copilot) notes and knowledge bases into QwenWork using the official ima OpenAPI. Includes a first-run credential setup guide; every user authenticates with their own ima API key.
descriptionEn: Bring Tencent ima (ima.copilot) notes and knowledge bases into QwenWork using the official ima OpenAPI. Includes a first-run credential setup guide; every user authenticates with their own ima API key.
descriptionZh: 基于 ima 官方 OpenAPI，把腾讯 ima（ima.copilot）的笔记与知识库接入千问办公，直接浏览、搜索、读取原文、上传与记笔记。内置首次凭证配置引导，每位用户使用自己的 ima API Key 鉴权。
